verdict.rationale: Sentry's first-party docs describe running all of Sentry on your own server at no cost, and community users report running self-hosted Sentry for years as rock-solid and as an escape hatch from vendor lock-in. Caveats are that the setup is minimal with no guarantees or dedicated support, self-hosted releases lag behind SaaS, and some users found it increasingly resource-heavy. Missing for 10: supported or production-grade self-hosting guarantees, evidence that AI features like Seer and MCP work on self-hosted, and a lighter footprint at scale.
